summary: feat(design-tokens): adopt Nova tokens behind a feature flag
description:
Because:
 - Firefox's Nova design system now ships as acorn-web-components; FxA's colours
   should come from it, behind a flag so the refresh lands incrementally and can
   be toggled/rolled back without a frontend deploy. FXA-14254.

This commit:
 - Adds libs/shared/design-tokens: Acorn's tokens.css + static legacy.css
   (:root:not([data-theme="nova"])) and nova-aliases.css ([data-theme="nova"]).
 - Points the fxa-react Tailwind palette at var(--…) (opacity via color-mix) and
   imports the token layer in fxa-react/styles and admin-panel.
 - Adds featureFlags.novaDesignSystem and sets data-theme="nova" on the settings shell.
 - Adds a Nova toggle to the Storybook toolbar for design review.
